title: Windsurf 2.0 - Devin Integration & Agent Command Center
description: Windsurf 2.0 released with Devin cloud agent available directly in the editor, new Agent Command Center with Kanban-style view for managing agent sessions, and numerous performance improvements.

title: v0.38.0 - Chapters Narrative Flow & Context Compression
description: Introduced Chapters narrative flow for grouping agent interactions, context compression service, UI flicker fixes with Terminal Buffer mode, and persistent policy approvals.

title: v0.37.0 - Dynamic Sandbox Expansion & Worktree Support
description: Implemented dynamic sandbox expansion and worktree support for Linux/Windows, enhanced browser agent with persistent sessions, and introduced tool-based topic grouping.

title: Adaptive Model Router & Bug Fixes
description: Fixed bug with adaptive model router preventing model switching after first request, and improved visibility of adaptive model in model picker.

title: Adaptive Model with Intelligent Pricing
description: New Adaptive model option that intelligently selects the best model for each task, with updated model picker showing token pricing information and prompt cache timer.
